description: Indicateurs de perception de la qualité de service is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ce jeu de données présente les résultats annuels de l’indicateur global de perception de la qualité de service, issus de l’enquête perception réalisée par Île-de-France Mobilités auprès des voyageurs dans le cadre des contrats RATP (Train, Métro, Tramway et Bus: Paris, Bus en site propre, Petite Couronne, Noctilien), SNCF (Train, Tram-Train et Noctilien), ainsi que ... Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Fréquentation & Statistiques. Its keywords are Qualité de service, Perception. The portal shows 2026-04-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
